Package com.example.volt.selected

Class DestinationReorderableQueue

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.selected.DestinationReorderableQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
DestinationCollection
public class DestinationReorderableQueue extends Object implements DestinationCollection
DestinationReorderableQueue is a collection of Destinations that can be reordered, notify listeners for changes and managed in a queue-like style.

Representation Invariant:

  • destinations != null
  • listeners != null
  • foreach destination in destinations: destination != null
  • foreach listener in listeners: listener != null

Abstraction Function:

DestinationReorderableQueue drq represents a collection of destinations that can be reordered and managed in a queue-like style such that:
  • drq.destinations are the Destinations in the collection such that drq.destinations[i] is the ith Destination.
  • drq.listeners is a collection of objects that want to be notified when the collection changes.
